enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Turns to right side. Stretches legs. Moves arm. Snores lightly. Turns again. Remains asleep. Turns to back. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering, brushing teeth and getting dressed for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Turns off alarm. Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Steps into shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses off. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Wipes face. Puts on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, packing a snack and water bottle
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out milk and yogurt. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out bowl and cereal box. Pours cereal into bowl. Pours milk over cereal. Picks up spoon. Eats breakfast. Drinks juice. Washes bowl and spoon. Puts them in drying rack. Opens pantry. Takes out granola bar. Puts granola bar in backpack. Fills water bottle from tap. Puts water bottle in backpack.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to Monash University Clayton campus
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up backpack. Walks out of house. Locks front door. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Checks phone. Board bus. Taps transit card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone again. Gets off bus. Walks to train station. Boards train. Finds seat. Reads notes. Gets off train. Walks to campus.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending business lectures and tutorials at Monash Clayton
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into lecture hall. Finds seat. Sits down. Opens laptop. Takes out notebook. Writes notes. Listens to lecturer. Raises hand. Asks question. Checks phone. Continues writing. Closes laptop. Packs bag. Walks to tutorial room. Finds seat. Sits down. Opens laptop. Participates in discussion. Takes notes. Closes laptop. Packs bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus and chatting with classmates
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to campus cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects sandwich and salad. Pays at cashier. Finds table. Sits down with classmates. Says 'Hi, how's it going?' Opens sandwich wrapper. Takes bite. Chews. Listens to classmate. Says 'That's interesting.' Drinks water. Continues eating. Laughs. Says 'I have to go to the library.' Picks up tray. Throws away trash. Says 'See you later.' Walks to library.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying and working on assignments on the laptop in the campus library
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into library. Finds empty desk. Sits down. Opens laptop. Connects to Wi-Fi. Opens assignment file. Reads instructions. Types on keyboard. Pauses. Checks phone. Continues typing. Opens browser. Searches for reference. Reads article. Takes notes. Types more. Saves file. Stretches. Gets up. Walks to bathroom. Returns. Sits down. Continues working.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting from Clayton to Chadstone for the retail shift
enriched_activities.desc: Packs laptop and notebooks. Walks out of library. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to train station. Boards train. Finds seat. Sits down. Listens to music. Gets off train. Walks to Chadstone shopping centre.

enriched_activities.activity: Working part-time retail shift at Chadstone shopping centre
enriched_activities.desc: Enters store. Greets manager. Clocks in. Puts on name badge. Walks to shop floor. Folds clothes. Hangs clothes on rack. Assists customer. Says 'Can I help you?' Answers question. Walks to register. Operates cash register. Scans items. Takes payment. Gives receipt. Says 'Thank you.' Straightens shelves. Checks stock. Helps another customer. Folds more clothes. Clocks out.

Walks out of store. Says goodbye to manager. Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Gets off bus. Walks to train station. Boards train. Finds seat. Sits down. Closes eyes. Gets off train. Walks home. Unlocks door. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Heating and eating a late dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out leftovers. Closes refrigerator. Opens microwave. Places leftovers in microwave. Closes microwave door. Presses start button. Waits. Microwave beeps. Opens microwave. Takes out food. Picks up fork. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Washes plate and fork. Puts them in drying rack. Turns off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the couch watching TV and scrolling on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Turns on TV. Picks up remote. Sits on couch. Changes channel. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Scrolls through social media. Watches TV. Changes channel again. Puts phone down. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Replies to message. Watches TV. Turns off TV. Gets up from couch.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and brushing teeth before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting an alarm, reviewing notes briefly under the desk lamp, then going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up phone. Sets alarm for 6:45. Puts phone on nightstand. Opens notebook. Reviews notes. Closes notebook. Turns off desk lamp. Lies down on bed. Pulls blanket up. Closes eyes. Falls asleep.
